---
title: "ibm_verify_events_transformed.events_auth_total_logins"
description: "Daily CanadaLogin-wide authentication event totals."
---

Daily, CanadaLogin-wide authentication event totals across all applications.

Each row is one day. It counts what IBM Verify calls the `authentication` event
type, raised each time someone presents an authentication method.

[`events_app_login_counts`](events_app_login_counts.qmd) counts a different event
type (`sso`). Never add the two tables' figures together or show them side by side.

`Keywords`: authentication events, sign-ins, logins, totals, CanadaLogin overall, unique users, daily

## Provenance

Built from [`authentication_activity`](../ibm_verify_events_raw/authentication_activity.qmd)
by `compute_auth_total_logins()` in the [daily metrics
job](https://github.com/cds-snc/canadalogin-reporting-data-pipeline/blob/main/infra/modules/ibm_verify_events_streaming/glue_src/ibm_verify_events_metrics_daily.py).

* **Updated**: Daily, at 04:00 ET, for the previous ET day
* **Retention**: While CanadaLogin exists
* **Steward**: EDCP Data and Research Team
* **Contact**: [Yinlin Zhang](mailto:yinlin.zhang@cds-snc.ca)
* **Location**: `s3://<transformed-bucket>/ibm_verify_metrics/events_auth_total_logins/`

## Fields

One row per day.

| Field Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| from_date | string | The reporting day in ET, for example "2026-09-15". Cast before comparing to a date |
| to_date | string | Same as `from_date` |
| unique_users | bigint | Distinct users with any authentication event that day, successful or not |
| failed_logins | bigint | Failed authentication events that day |
| successful_logins | bigint | Successful authentication events that day |
| mtd_unique_users | bigint | Distinct users month-to-date. Resets on the 1st |
| ytd_unique_users | bigint | Distinct users year-to-date. Resets on January 1 |
| fetched_at | string | When the job wrote the row, in ISO 8601 UTC |
| date | string | Partition key. Same as `from_date` |

## Notes

`unique_users`, `failed_logins`, and `successful_logins` are daily values. The
`mtd_` and `ytd_` columns are cumulative: take the latest value in the window,
never sum them.

**`unique_users` includes failed attempts.** It counts anyone with an
authentication event, even if every attempt failed. The literal user ID
`"UNKNOWN"`, logged for a password attempt on a username that does not exist,
counts as one user. Both match IBM's own figures.

**Events overcount sign-ins.** Each authentication method is its own event. A
password plus a second factor is two successful events, and a mistyped password
adds a failed one. Use `unique_users` for engagement. Reaching an application
adds nothing here; that is an SSO event in
[`events_app_login_counts`](events_app_login_counts.qmd).
